# GitHub Multiverse v10: version launcher, theater mode and every update since v8
Here is everything that landed since v8, in one place.

## Launcher and versions
- **Launcher after login** (Eaglercraft / Decentraland style): Home, Play, Servers, Worlds, Resource Packs and News tabs, a search, sorting, a big LAUNCH GAME panel and settings for graphics and sound.
- **Play any version, from v1 to v10.** The Home tab lists the milestones of the project with a real screenshot of each build and a title for what changed. Picking an older one plays that build exactly as it was, loaded from the repository history. Its progress is kept apart from the current version.
- **Worlds tab** with screenshots of every separate world (Silicon Valley, Crypto Valley, JPEG World, Squid Game Epic Edition and more). The **Play tab** lists the starting points plus every district of Genesis City with its screenshot.
- **Daily bonus**: +50 MVC every 20 hours, claimed from the launcher.
- **Login panorama**: screenshots of the worlds and districts drift slowly and cross-fade behind the welcome card, like the Minecraft title screen.
- **Theater mode**: press Esc in game (with no panel open) and the game keeps running in a smaller window with a bar below it: back to fullscreen, controls, reload, more (map, metro, invite link, screenshot mode) and exit to the launcher. Esc again, or a click on the game, goes back in.

## Worlds and districts
- **Squid Game Epic Edition**: a separate world on its own bare concrete island, like Round 6 on Roblox, but for developers. Red Build Green Build, Regex Honeycomb, Merge Conflict Tug of War, Odd or Even Commits, the Glass Bridge of Code Review and a dormitory with an MVC piggy bank. Nobody gets hurt, builds just fail. It's on the Worlds Express metro line.
- **House of MAC**: images on every outdoor billboard, an iMac G3 billboard, an indoor reel of clips, a macOS section and MacBooks on the Avenue tables that open a working macOS-style demo (Finder, Safari, Terminal, Notes, Calculator, Settings, Spotlight).
- **Genesis City**: grass is back on most parcels, with stone around the plaza and on scattered squares, and the neighborhoods fill the whole commons.

## Gameplay
- **Gather resources**: Code Crystals, Coffee Beans, RAM, Git Gems, Bugs and Tokens around Genesis City. E or G picks up the nearest one, holding G pulls in everything nearby, and `/bag` shows what you carry.
- **Decentraland-style scenes**: estates, scene manifests with per-parcel limits, the in-game Builder (B) on your own parcels, server validation and sync, lazy scene loading and `/goto`.
- **JUMP IN cards** work with a click and show real screenshots of each place.

## Look and feel
- Realistic surfaces: stone, brick, wood, plaster, roofs, concrete, metal, asphalt, fabric, marble, sand, grass and water with relief, and glass facades with lit offices at night.
- Firelight that flickers, with night shadows at the firepits and campfires.

Have fun, and tell us what you think in the other categories.
